name: 2026-06-27 — The Archivist's Index
inGameDate: ~3 weeks after Ep 1 (late summer / early autumn 2026)
scenes: Reconvene at Ocean Beach + teenagers with a bonfire
Bag chain-of-custody inspection + Waymo to SFO
SFO ticketing — two frontal approaches, both fail
Reggie sighted in the departure hall → 11pm Daly City In-N-Out
Starbucks the next morning — Bea finds them
summary: Weeks after Flight 887, the five reconvened at Ocean Beach and followed the empty anti-static bag back toward SFO. A teenager at a bonfire helped them notice that the chain of custody stopped at the airport. Two frontal approaches at ticketing failed and got them referred to a legal department. They spotted Reggie in the departure hall by coincidence; he was visibly rattled by Dakota and by Yui's name, and agreed to meet them at the Daly City In-N-Out at 11pm. The footage showed everything and proved nothing. The next morning at a Starbucks, Bea Ferro found them — and that afternoon, at her house in the Outer Sunset, showed them the index cards she had been keeping on exactly this kind of thing for forty years.
playedNotes: Run as the compressed 4-scene variant rather than the canonical 7 (see episodes/002-the-archivists-index/dm/pacing.md).
The Ocean Beach teenagers were added to a second group chat — the origin of hook T4.
The flight-attendant scene was vestigial: the party tried, nothing came of it.
The compressed shape let Bea arrive as a coincidence coming to the PCs, which is thematically load-bearing.
Marsh's galaxies-sentient clipping did NOT surface — most trio-plus material was cut. This is hook B15, and it needs re-planting.
